manage_budget_clear_desc: This sets remaining budget to 0. All agents will stop immediately. Use the Set button with a new amount to restore.
manage_budget_adjust_hint: Amount is in the selected unit (K = thousand, M = million, B = billion tokens). Increase/decrease adjusts budget by the amount; Set sets the remaining tokens directly (0 = pause all).
manage_budget_budget_cleared_hint: Remaining budget is 0. All agents are stopped. Enter an amount above to restore.
manage_budget_clear_hint: Sets remaining budget to 0 — all agents will stop immediately.
